description: `IMDSCredentialsResolver`, `IMDSClient`, `IMDSTokenCache` and `Ec2InstanceMetadataProvider` are now synchronous. The async implementations are now `AsyncIMDSCredentialsResolver`, `AsyncIMDSClient`, `AsyncIMDSTokenCache` and `AsyncEc2InstanceMetadataProvider` in `aws_credentials_imds.aio`. Update async code to the `Async` names.
